patterns.name: Factory Method
required_relations: creator CONTAINS a method that INSTANTIATES a product type
creator has >=2 subclasses/callers selecting different concrete products
behavioral_signals: the creation method's return type is the abstract product, not the concrete one
patterns.opportunity_signal: repeated selection among concrete classes at multiple call sites

patterns.name: Abstract Factory
required_relations: concrete_factory IMPLEMENTS abstract_factory
abstract_factory CONTAINS >=2 creation methods returning different abstract_product families
each creation method INSTANTIATES a concrete_product matching the concrete_factory's family
behavioral_signals: concrete factories are interchangeable at a single composition point
patterns.opportunity_signal: families of related objects created through scattered conditionals

patterns.name: Builder
required_relations: builder CONTAINS >=2 methods that RETURNS the builder's own type (chaining)
builder CONTAINS a method that INSTANTIATES/RETURNS the product
behavioral_signals: chained calls culminate in one terminal build()/create() call
patterns.opportunity_signal: repeated complex construction with many optional parameters

patterns.name: Prototype
required_relations: prototype CONTAINS a method with a CLONES relation to itself
behavioral_signals: clone copies internal state without re-running the constructor
patterns.opportunity_signal: manual field-by-field copy of an existing instance repeated at call sites

patterns.name: Singleton
required_relations: class CACHES its own single instance
an accessor CONTAINS the only path that INSTANTIATES the class
behavioral_signals: repeated calls to the accessor return the same instance
patterns.opportunity_signal: global mutable state reached through ad hoc module-level access

patterns.name: Adapter
required_relations: adapter IMPLEMENTS target
adapter CONTAINS a reference to adaptee (CONTAINS/REFERENCES)
adapter DELEGATES_TO adaptee with a different method name/signature (translation)
behavioral_signals: target.operation() call is translated before reaching adaptee.other_operation()
patterns.opportunity_signal: repeated ad hoc conversion code between two incompatible APIs

patterns.name: Bridge
required_relations: abstraction CONTAINS a reference to implementor (composition, not inheritance)
refined_abstraction INHERITS abstraction
concrete_implementor IMPLEMENTS implementor
>=2 independent variations exist on each side
behavioral_signals: abstraction delegates the operation to implementor instead of implementing it
patterns.opportunity_signal: combinatorial explosion of subclasses covering two independent dimensions

patterns.name: Composite
required_relations: leaf IMPLEMENTS component
composite IMPLEMENTS component
composite CONTAINS a collection of component (including itself, recursively)
behavioral_signals: composite's operation ITERATES its children and CALLS the same operation on each
patterns.opportunity_signal: duplicated logic handling a single element and a group of elements separately

patterns.name: Decorator
required_relations: decorator IMPLEMENTS component
decorator CONTAINS a reference to a wrapped component
decorator DELEGATES_TO the wrapped component with the SAME method name/signature
decorator adds behavior before/after the delegated call
behavioral_signals: decorators are combinable/stackable around one another
patterns.opportunity_signal: growing combinations of optional behaviors layered ad hoc

patterns.name: Facade
required_relations: facade CONTAINS references to >=2 subsystem components
facade's methods CALLS across those subsystem components in a fixed sequence
behavioral_signals: clients no longer call the subsystem components directly
patterns.opportunity_signal: the same subsystem orchestration sequence repeated at multiple call sites

patterns.name: Flyweight
required_relations: flyweight_factory CACHES flyweight instances keyed by intrinsic state
context REFERENCES a shared flyweight instead of owning its own copy
behavioral_signals: extrinsic state is passed as a parameter, never stored on the flyweight
patterns.opportunity_signal: large duplicated intrinsic state across many instances (needs measured evidence before claiming a performance benefit — spec §20/§21)

patterns.name: Proxy
required_relations: proxy IMPLEMENTS subject
proxy CONTAINS a reference to real_subject
proxy DELEGATES_TO real_subject with the SAME method name/signature
proxy adds an access/lifecycle concern (guard, lazy init, cache) around the delegated call
behavioral_signals: the delegated call is conditionally short-circuited (access check, cache hit, lazy creation)
patterns.opportunity_signal: repeated access-control, lazy-loading, or caching logic wrapping direct calls

patterns.name: Chain of Responsibility
required_relations: concrete_handler IMPLEMENTS/INHERITS handler
handler CONTAINS a reference to the next handler in the chain
concrete_handler's handling method CALLS the next handler when it does not resolve the request
behavioral_signals: a request travels through more than one handler instance at runtime
patterns.opportunity_signal: a sequential pipeline of conditional handling checks

patterns.name: Command
required_relations: concrete_command IMPLEMENTS command
concrete_command CONTAINS a reference to receiver
concrete_command's execute method DELEGATES_TO receiver
invoker CONTAINS/REFERENCES command without knowing the concrete type
behavioral_signals: the invoker queues, logs, or undoes commands instead of calling receiver directly
patterns.opportunity_signal: actions that need queueing, history, or undo but call their receiver directly today

patterns.name: Iterator
required_relations: aggregate CONTAINS a method that RETURNS an iterator
iterator holds traversal state separate from the aggregate's own state
behavioral_signals: traversal position survives across multiple calls without the aggregate exposing its internals
patterns.opportunity_signal: repeated manual traversal/index bookkeeping duplicated at call sites

patterns.name: Mediator
required_relations: colleague CONTAINS a reference to mediator (not to other colleagues directly)
mediator CONTAINS references to >=2 colleagues
colleague-to-colleague communication is a CALLS through mediator, never a direct edge
behavioral_signals: mediator centralizes reactions to colleague events instead of colleagues reacting to each other
patterns.opportunity_signal: many-to-many direct dependencies between components that only need to react to each other's changes

patterns.name: Memento
required_relations: originator CONTAINS a method that INSTANTIATES/RETURNS a memento (snapshot)
originator CONTAINS a method that restores state FROM a memento
caretaker CONTAINS/REFERENCES mementos without reading their internals
behavioral_signals: memento's fields are opaque to caretaker and only originator reads them back
patterns.opportunity_signal: manual undo/rollback logic reconstructing prior state field by field

patterns.name: Observer
required_relations: subject CONTAINS a collection of observer references (homogeneous, >1 element type-compatible)
subject has a method that adds to that collection (REGISTERS) and one that removes from it
subject has a method that ITERATES the collection and CALLS the same method on each element (fan-out)
behavioral_signals: the fan-out call happens in reaction to subject's own state changing (NOTIFIES)
patterns.opportunity_signal: a producer calling multiple concrete consumers directly and by name

patterns.name: State
required_relations: context CONTAINS a reference to a state-typed field
concrete_state IMPLEMENTS/INHERITS state
context DELEGATES_TO the current state for behavior that varies by state
a TRANSITIONS_TO relation reassigns context's state field to a different concrete_state
behavioral_signals: the same context method returns different concrete behavior across the object's lifetime, driven by an internal transition
patterns.opportunity_signal: the same lifecycle discriminator (e.g. pending/running/failed/completed) repeated as conditionals across multiple methods, WITH evidence of transitions between values

patterns.name: Strategy
required_relations: context CONTAINS a reference to a strategy-typed field or parameter
concrete_strategy IMPLEMENTS/INHERITS strategy
context DELEGATES_TO the strategy for one interchangeable algorithm step
>=2 concrete_strategy implementations exist
behavioral_signals: the concrete strategy is selected by the caller/composition root, not by context's own internal state
patterns.opportunity_signal: the same discriminator repeated as conditionals across multiple functions, selecting between algorithm variants, WITHOUT evidence of state transitions

patterns.name: Template Method
required_relations: abstract_class CONTAINS a method that CALLS >=2 of its own overridable steps in a fixed sequence
concrete_class INHERITS abstract_class and overrides >=1 of those steps
behavioral_signals: the overall sequence never changes across concrete subclasses; only individual steps do
patterns.opportunity_signal: the same multi-step sequence repeated with small per-case variations

patterns.name: Visitor
required_relations: concrete_element CONTAINS an accept(visitor) method
accept DELEGATES_TO a type-specific method on visitor
visitor CONTAINS one method per concrete_element type
behavioral_signals: adding a new visitor operation requires no change to concrete_element, only a new visitor
patterns.opportunity_signal: multiple unrelated operations distributed across a stable class hierarchy via type checks
